anchor_from.rule: Q401 hangs from the fixed inductor: SW pad 9 under L401 pad 1, courtyard 1.05 mm below L401's; port 2 uses L501 the same way (a pure -23.026 mm translation).

Q401.rule: anchor. Rot 0 in its own frame: gate pins 1/8 face L401 (+y up = -y), D1 column (pads 2,3,4 + big pad 2) on the -x side toward the AC caps, S2 (5,6,7) on +x toward the FET gap. SW pad 9 sits under L401 pad 1 so SW1 runs straight up on F.Cu (anchor_from L401: dx -3.84, dy +7.19 = courtyard 1.05 mm under L401's, SW pad 9 inside L401.1's x span).

Q402.rule: r4_bcu: output switch hung from the RIGHT side of the fixed inductor's pad 2: rot 90 puts the gate edge (SW pad exit between the gate pins) facing L401.2, so SW2 joins the inductor on F.Cu over ~1 mm; courtyard abuts L401's courtyard; D1 (BAT) column at the bottom, S2 (GND) at the top, cap edge toward the board edge

C430.rule: HF input cap (first cap of HL_IN): centred on Q401 at the pins-4/5 edge, offset = switch courtyard half (1.945) + cap courtyard half (0.505) = 2.45; pad 1 (AC) under the D1 side, pad 2 (GND) under the SW/S2 side, so supply and return pours each join in one piece around the SW pad end.

C438.rule: r4_bcu: HF output cap centred on Q402's cap edge (offset courtyard half 1.945 + cap half 0.505), pad 1 (BAT) over D1 (bottom), pad 2 (GND) over S2 (top)

C420.rule: first AC bulk: vertical 1210 in the AC column against Q401's D1 side (courtyards abut), pad 1 (AC) at the bottom level with D1 pads 3/4, pad 2 (GND) at the top gets its own return vias. Column x is the leftmost the port-2 copy allows (port-2 courtyard >= 79.4).

C423.rule: second AC bulk: horizontal under C430 and Q401's D1 corner, pad 1 (AC) on the right touching C430.1's pour, pad 2 (GND) left with vias.

C424.rule: non-loop AC bulk: groundup column slot above C420 (AC pad facing the stage).

C427.rule: non-loop AC bulk: groundup column slot above C424.

C431.rule: r4_bcu: first BAT bulk: horizontal 1210 left of the BAT drop under Q402's D1 edge (courtyard abuts Q402's), BAT pad (1) on the right touching the drop, GND pad left with return vias

C434.rule: r4_bcu: second BAT bulk: horizontal 1210 under C431, BAT pad on the right touching the drop, GND pad left with return vias

TH401.rule: FET-temperature NTC: under Q401's S2 corner (+1.53, +3.5), GND pad up into the HL_IN return pour, TS pad down toward U403; out of the loop and off the S2 via sites.

R446.rule: r4_bcu: HG2 gate resistor beside U403's HIDRV2 pin (HIDRV2 pad down); HG2 reaches Q402's gate through the gate escape via

R447.rule: r4_bcu: LG2 gate resistor straight above Q402's LG2 pin (top-left), LG2 pad toward the pin

R445.rule: LG1 gate resistor inside the FET gap (+2.915, -0.5): pad 2 level with Q401 pin 8 (LG1, top-right), pad 1 (LODRV1) leaves down the gap. Its pads also stop SW2 from wrapping round Q402 through the gap.

R427.rule: r4_bcu: BAT sense resistor straight below Q402's D1 edge: BAT drops ~6 mm from D1 to its pad 1 (top); pad 2 (PACK_P) next to J113

R428.rule: r4_bcu: Kelvin filter at R427 pad 1 (SRP), left of it

R429.rule: r4_bcu: Kelvin filter at R427 pad 2 (SRN), left of it

D405.rule: r4_bcu: BTST2/DRV_SUP diode under C434 between C411 (DRV_SUP) and the BTST2 cap C413

D410.rule: r4_bcu: DRV_SUP/REGN diode between the two Kelvin filters, DRV_SUP pad toward C411/D405

keep_rule: keep boxes (switch frame) are no-go areas for re-placed neighbours: the FET gap lane for LODRV1/GND. r4_bcu: second box = the BAT drop from Q402 (hung right of L401.2) down to R427 pad 1.
frame: dx, dy in mm in the anchor switch's frame (fpdb rotv, KiCad y down); drot added to the anchor's absolute rotation. Port 2 = refs 4xx->5xx anchored on Q501 (from L501).
r4_bcu_note: Q402 rot 90 hung from the RIGHT side of L401 pad 2 (gate edge = SW exit faces the inductor pad): SW2 joins L401.2 on F.Cu over ~1 mm instead of a B.Cu via blob. Port-2 extra: R554 moved to (98.55, 94.15, 180) (abs, see overrides/60_r4_bcu.json).
